quarterly_data.quarter: Hubei Dinglong results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual collective (07-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Board secretary Yang Pingcai (Hubei listed companies' collective 2025 results briefing): besides its wafer photoresists, the company has positioned several matching lithography auxiliary materials such as BARC and SOC, with commercialisation accelerating, and expected photoresist deliveries in H1 2026 to rise significantly. Its polishing pads cover the mainstream domestic wafer makers across process nodes for logic and memory, existing capacity fully meets current orders and capacity is added in step with fabs' expansion. Its YPI and PSPI display materials are used in volume in the flexible OLED chain, covering nearly all mainstream domestic brands' foldable phones, made on what it calls China's first thousand-tonne automated polyimide line. Strategy: semiconductor materials stay the core, with lithium-battery materials as the second growth curve. R&D investment was RMB 4.62 hundred million in 2024.
